Photo 1 shows the same mixer from a different angle, with the brand label visible on the yellow body. The label includes Chinese characters and some technical specs.
The mixer has a robust, heavy-duty design with a wide handle for grip and a motor housing with cooling vents.
The spiral mixing attachment appears to be made of stainless steel and is attached to the shaft via a chuck.
The power cord is black and appears to be standard, with no visible damage in the photos.
The label on the motor housing in photo 1 shows 'LUBU' in English and Chinese characters, along with '220V 50Hz' and '1.5KW'.
